results.question: 各品类这个月相比上个月增长了多少
results.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_time >= '2026-12-01' AND order_time < '2027-01-01' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS cur_sales, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_time >= '2026-11-01' AND order_time < '2026-12-01' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS prev_sales, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_time >= '2026-12-01' AND order_time < '2027-01-01' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN order_time >= '2026-11-01' AND order_time < '2026-12-01' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS growth_amount, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN order_time >= '2026-12-01' AND order_time < '2027-01-01' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN order_time >= '2026-11-01' AND order_time < '2026-12-01' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_time >= '2026-11-01' AND order_time < '2026-12-01' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END),0),4) AS growth_rate FROM orders WHERE order_time >= '2026-11-01' AND order_time < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY category ORDER BY growth_amount DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 各省份这个月销售额环比变化
results.sql: SELECT t.region, t.cur_sales, t.cur_orders, t.prev_sales, t.prev_orders, ROUND(t.cur_sales - t.prev_sales, 2) AS sales_diff, ROUND((t.cur_sales - t.prev_sales) / NULLIF(t.prev_sales, 0), 4) AS mom_rate FROM (SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_time >= '2026-12-01' AND order_time < '2027-01-01' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS cur_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_time >= '2026-12-01' AND order_time < '2027-01-01' THEN order_id END) AS cur_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_time >= '2026-11-01' AND order_time < '2026-12-01' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS prev_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_time >= '2026-11-01' AND order_time < '2026-12-01' THEN order_id END) AS prev_orders FROM orders WHERE order_time >= '2026-11-01' AND order_time < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY region) t ORDER BY t.cur_sales DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 复购率分别是多少，有多少用户下过两单以上
按 RFM 分层（R≤30天且F≥3为高价值，R≤60天为潜力，R>90天且F≤1为流失，其余为一般），各层人数和销售额
results.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(SUM(money), 2) AS sales FROM (SELECT user_id, money, CASE WHEN r_days <= 30 AND f_cnt >= 3 THEN '高价值' WHEN r_days <= 60 THEN '潜力' WHEN r_days > 90 AND f_cnt <= 1 THEN '流失' ELSE '一般' END AS segment FROM (SELECT user_id, DATEDIFF('2026-12-31', MAX(order_time)) AS r_days, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS f_cnt, SUM(total_amount) AS money FROM orders GROUP BY user_id) t) s GROUP BY segment ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 各月销售目标完成率分别是多少
results.sql: SELECT t.period_value AS month, t.target_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(o.actual_sales, 0), 2) AS actual_sales, ROUND(COALESCE(o.actual_sales, 0) / NULLIF(t.target_amount, 0), 4) AS achieve_rate FROM sales_target t LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS actual_sales FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m')) o ON o.month = t.period_value WHERE t.period_type = 'month' AND t.category = 'ALL' ORDER BY t.period_value ASC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 各月销售目标、实际销售额和缺口分别是多少
results.sql: SELECT m.period_value AS month, ROUND(t.target_amount, 2) AS target_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(o.actual_sales, 0), 2) AS actual_sales, ROUND(COALESCE(t.target_amount, 0) - COALESCE(o.actual_sales, 0), 2) AS gap FROM (SELECT period_value FROM sales_target WHERE period_type = 'month' AND category = 'ALL' UNION SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m') FROM orders) m LEFT JOIN sales_target t ON t.period_type = 'month' AND t.category = 'ALL' AND t.period_value = m.period_value LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS actual_sales FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m')) o ON o.month = m.period_value ORDER BY month LIMIT 1000

results.question: 平均每单买几件商品
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(qty), 4) AS avg_items_per_order, SUM(qty) AS total_items, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS qty FROM orders GROUP BY order_id) t LIMIT 1000

results.question: 各品类的客单价是多少
results.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(total_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id),4) AS aov FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 各品类的客单价分别是多少
results.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(total_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id),4) AS aov FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 每个品类有多少订单
results.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS numerator_orders, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders) AS total_orders, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders), 4) AS order_share FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 每个省份各品类的销售额分布
results.sql: SELECT region, category, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS sales, ROUND(SUM(total_amount) / SUM(SUM(total_amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 4) AS share_in_region FROM orders WHERE region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region, category ORDER BY region, sales DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 今年每月累计销售额走势如何
results.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) AS month_sales, ROUND(SUM(SUM(total_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(order_time,'%Y-%m')),2) AS cum_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_time >= '2026-01-01' AND order_time < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_time,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY month LIMIT 1000

results.question: 最近7天的滚动平均销售额走势
results.sql: SELECT d, ROUND(ma7, 2) AS ma7_sales FROM (SELECT d, AVG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma7 FROM (SELECT DATE(order_time) AS d, SUM(total_amount) AS sales FROM orders WHERE order_time >= '2026-12-19' AND order_time < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY d) t) x WHERE d >= '2026-12-25' AND d < '2027-01-01' ORDER BY d LIMIT 1000

results.question: 每个季度的销售额和订单量
results.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(order_time), '-Q', QUARTER(order_time)) AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS sales, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter ASC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 手机品类各价格带的销量分布
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN price IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN price < 1000 THEN '0-1000' WHEN price < 3000 THEN '1000-3000' WHEN price < 5000 THEN '3000-5000' ELSE '5000+' END AS price_band, SUM(quantity) AS qty, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders WHERE category = '手机' GROUP BY price_band ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 平均每个用户下几单
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS total_users, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 4) AS avg_orders_per_user FROM orders LIMIT 1000

results.question: 手机品类销售额最高的5个商品
results.sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders WHERE category = '手机' GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5
